description: PERSEUS-PtX: European Energy System Model and Dataset is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Chair of Energy Economics, Institute for Industrial Production (IIP), Julia Schuler (Karlsruhe Institute of Technology). This repository contains the complete code and dataset of the European energy system model PERSEUS-PtX, a member of the PERSEUS model family. The model enables the analysis of European energy system transformation pathways with a particular focus on hydrogen and reactive metals. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
